title: Fazoli's
text: Took a friend to Fazoli's for her Birthday. The food and service was Great. Joe Deloney was our server and Keisha helped too. They were both awesome I will be going back soon. Thank you Joe  and Keisha.

title: The right man at the right place
text:
Hello everybody! I  am Mioara Tunea, 
the Tour Leader of a group of 58 Romanuan tourists coming from Timișoara, Romania! We all have been, recently,  in Hurghada at Long Beach Resort and during our stay in the hotel I have been helped and assisted by a very good and initiative person from The Concierge Office : Mr.RAMADAN FATHY. I thank him a lot for all his kindness and immediate assistance and I really hope to meet him again our next time in the Hotel !

title: Book this Tour and you won’t be disappointed.
text: We had great time in this tour to Frigiliana and Nerja. Our driver picked us from the Port and drove us around , he was very friendly and really funny . When we arrived at Frigiliana , there was a Tour guide waiting for us and showed us around this beautiful white village and then we went to the Caves and Nerja . This kids had a blast and they loved the Caves.
author: MVPGA

title: Must Do!
text: What a beautiful tour! We were picked up at the port and our driver took us to Nerja. On the way there, he was giving us information about the region and everything else we needed to know to set us up with the city tours with Ana. Both towns were spectacular and Ana sure did not disappoint as a guide! Must do!
author: Alessandria_S
